论文 §8.4 在一张 A100 上用 LLaMA 13B 运行 MetaGPT.en: Section 8.4 of the paper runs a MetaGPT-style architect, coder, and reviewer workflow with LLaMA 13B on an A100, observing improvements in end-to-end time and KV memory. Shared prefixes, scheduled batches, and dedicated attention implementations all contribute. The measurements compare against baselines such as FastChat/vLLM from the time of the paper and mainly address serving efficiency. This set of results does not verify code correctness with a modern repository closed-loop fix. The code is public as ParrotServe, and larger system experiments also include other applications and LLaMA 7B.

角色执行顺序能为缓存调度提供复用信号，提前准备也需要与前台请求竞争资源。论文关注.en: The execution order of roles can provide reuse signals for cache scheduling, and prefetching must also compete with foreground requests for resources. The paper focuses on fixed-prefix serving efficiency. Experiments in Q&A, dialogue, search, and coding scenarios mainly compare TTFT, per-turn latency, throughput, and cache hits. The exact harness and engine versions remain unverified.

在九个自建编码、技术写作和规划任务上，作者报告相较 Claude Code 的平.en: On nine in-house coding, technical writing, and planning tasks, the authors report an average wall-clock speedup of about 2.6x over Claude Code, with delivered words per second increasing by about 2.2x. This throughput definition depends on both artifact length and completion time, while quality is rated separately by Claude Opus 4.6 for each task entry. The execution model is Claude Sonnet 4.6. Generation length is predictive for model-generation-dominated tasks, while tool execution, external API calls, and service queuing still require separate timing. The current evaluation focuses mainly on in-house artifact tasks.

动态文本产物与前缀 KV.en: Dynamic text artifacts and prefix KV

多个编码 Agent 并行工作时，普通消息需要接收者自行记住何时使用某条发现，也.en: When multiple coding Agents work in parallel, ordinary messages require receivers to remember when to use a finding, and upstream and downstream must also check whether agreements were implemented. AECP has a lead divide modules, then uses two types of structured artifacts to coordinate parallel workers.

在 Doc2Repo、NL2Repo 和 CodeProjectEval 的从规.en: In repository generation from specifications on Doc2Repo, NL2Repo, and CodeProjectEval, the authors report that AECP improves hidden-test pass rates and shortens wall-clock time compared with two team baselines. Compared with a single Agent, it uses more output tokens on average. The first-step ablation against the integrator baseline introduces both a shared workspace and knowledge artifacts, so the comparison cannot be attributed to knowledge delivery alone. The main experiment uses the AWS Strands Agents SDK, with a separate verification run using mini-SWE-agent. Claude Opus 4.8, Opus 4.6, and Sonnet 5 are called through Bedrock, while DeepSeek-V4-Flash and GLM-5.2 are called through OpenRouter. The underlying engine and hardware are not disclosed.

系统基于 Claude Agent SDK，公开代码支持 Git worktre.en: The system is based on the Claude Agent SDK, and the public code supports Git worktree isolation. The underlying inference engine and server hardware are not disclosed. The paper's prompts and task descriptions are public, and no new model training was required.

先递归建树，同时以列表保存每个节点的左右孩子。这里需要注意递归的过程中会改变全局.en: Build the tree recursively while storing each node's left and right children in a list. Note that recursion would modify global variables, so save the index in a local variable to avoid changes. Then, during BFS, restore the multi-way tree and mirror it at the same time. Using the left-child/right-sibling representation, iterating over children means repeatedly visiting the right sibling of the left child until reaching -1. The problem asks for a mirror image, so during BFS we only need to enqueue all nodes in the current level (the children of the previous node) in reverse order.

使用的花枝宽427，而明信片画布宽500。此前没有对应位置数据，树枝回退到左上角.en: uses a 427-pixel-wide branch asset, while the postcard canvas is 500 pixels wide. Without position data, the branch defaulted to the upper-left corner, leaving an obvious gap on the right; its shadow also appeared in the sky.

现在按素材尺寸将花枝右移73像素，使它贴住画面右边缘。投影放回右侧瓦面。新生成的.en: The branch is now shifted 73 pixels to the right, based on the asset dimensions, so it meets the right edge of the canvas. Its shadow is placed back on the roof tiles on the right. Newly generated photos and album detail views use these positions. When loading older photos, the returned layers are corrected without changing the original save data. These positions are a local calibration based on the canvas boundaries and asset shapes.

特产选择页中的苹果、椰子等图标也对照了原始图集。原始裁切尺寸分别为187×189.en: The apple, coconut, and other icons on the souvenir selection page were also checked against the original texture atlas. The original crop sizes are 187x189 and 208x206, respectively; scaling them down to item slots produces the corresponding edges and textures. No incorrect images or additional quality loss in the image-loading path were found, so the original assets were retained.

日历的奖励判断、庭院入口和红点现在使用相同的可领取条件。当月已经到日期、尚未领取.en: Calendar reward checks, the courtyard entry, and its notification dot now use the same eligibility conditions. Lucky-day gifts in the current month whose dates have arrived but that have not yet been claimed can trigger a notification; solar-term dishes still require completing their respective tasks.

除了加载日历时刷新，还在庭院界面创建、同步完成、网页回到前台及每分钟检查时更新。.en: Updates now occur not only when loading the calendar, but also when creating the courtyard view, after synchronization, when the web page returns to the foreground, and during the check each minute. After a date change or re-entering the courtyard, a reward should no longer appear only inside the calendar while its entry is missing from the home screen. Once all rewards have been claimed, the courtyard entry and notification dot disappear together; the calendar remains accessible in the small storehouse.

此前所有放入堆肥箱的物品都按两小时完成吸收，缓释肥虽然有较长的后续肥效，物品本身.en: Previously, all items placed in the compost bin finished being absorbed after two hours. Slow-release fertilizer had a longer subsequent effect, but the item itself disappeared just as quickly. Absorption time and the duration of the fertilizer effect are now handled separately.

当前离线时长设置为普通肥料一天、缓释肥三天、普通特产半天。新放入后的五分钟取回窗.en: The current offline settings give regular fertilizer one day to be absorbed, slow-release fertilizer three days, and ordinary souvenirs half a day. The five-minute retrieval window after placing an item is retained; once fermentation begins, items are absorbed sequentially from the queue. The subsequent effects of regular and slow-release fertilizer still last one day and three days, respectively, and fertility from absorbed materials continues to accumulate in the soil. Item descriptions establish that slow-release fertilizer acts more slowly and lasts longer; the specific durations are adjustable local rules.

蜡梅的两张原始贴图是花苞和开花，不能统一解释为新鲜与枯萎。这次按花材种类拆开生命.en: The two original wintersweet textures depict buds and blooms, so they cannot both be interpreted as fresh and wilted stages. The life cycle is now handled separately for each type of flower.

花圃培育的花材.en: Flowers grown in the flower bed

五天新鲜，两天枯萎.en: Five days fresh, two days wilted

阶段切换沿用原本的贴图和客户端状态。时间以插花时记录的时间戳计算，重进不会重置；.en: Stage changes retain the original textures and client states. Timing is calculated from the timestamp recorded when the flowers were arranged and is not reset on re-entry; expiry cleanup happens only once. The precise official-server durations were not found in the preserved resources, so these local durations are based on play feedback. Flowers that have already been cleared and lack their original records need to be arranged again before their behavior can be observed.

图鉴版购买后保持9999三叶草，不能用余额下降来判断是否花过草。现在成功购买普通.en: The Gallery Edition keeps 9999 clover after purchases, so a falling balance cannot be used to determine whether clover was spent. A successful purchase from the regular shop or Dudu's shop now advances the gashapon machine's "Spend Some Clover" task by the actual listed price. Blocked, refunded, or free operations do not add spending progress.

另外使用隔离的图鉴版存档验证了完整旅行流程。.en: The complete travel flow was also verified using an isolated Gallery Edition save.

花瓶阶段、不同肥料的吸收时长、图鉴版购买任务、旧照片图层读取和旅行返程的五组回归.en: Five groups of regression tests passed: vase stages, absorption times for different fertilizers, Gallery Edition purchase tasks, loading older photo layers, and travel returns. Separate calendar checks covered claiming overdue rewards after a date change, courtyard resynchronization, and hiding the entry after all rewards are claimed. Testing used dedicated data; the changes remain local for the next release.

介绍页、下载与正式发布.en: Introduction page, downloads, and official release

2026 年 11 月 6 日发布 v0.2.3。Windows 可使用安装器或.en: v0.2.3 was released on November 6, 2026. On Windows, use the installer or the ZIP for the corresponding version; on Android, two signed APKs are provided. At deploy time, the homepage fetches the web runtime package from a pinned release, and the Amy Studio project card opens a page for choosing the Normal or Gallery edition.

日历按北京时间更新月份，节气料理排在每年的实际节气日期。离线版每月另外随机安排两.en: The calendar updates its month in Beijing time, and solar-term dishes are scheduled on each year's actual solar-term dates. In the offline edition, two or three lucky-day gifts are additionally scheduled at random each month and saved with the save file. Rewards missed that month can be claimed later; the courtyard shows the calendar only when a reward is available, while the small warehouse keeps a calendar entry. Reclaimable starter gifts share the layout of other rewards in date cells; click the icon to claim.

动态照片1号位的过路照也进行了坐标修复。图鉴版以动态照片教程已完成的状态进入，玩.en: The coordinates of the passing photo in animated-photo slot 1 were also fixed. The Gallery Edition starts with the animated-photo tutorial already completed, so players can open the creation page directly.

新存档预置正式配置中的默认称号「一只蛙的旅行」，旧档缺少这一项时会补齐。首次获得.en: New saves are preset with the default title "A Frog's Journey" from the official configuration; older saves missing this entry will have it filled in. After obtaining the first qualifying travel item, the Travel Encyclopedia selects the exhibit that is actually unlocked. The Plant Encyclopedia updates as the player obtains plants.

工具套装和材料套装可分别用一枚三叶草向嘟嘟购买。小摊的标题与首排商品之间留出空间.en: Tool sets and material sets can each be purchased from Dudu for one clover. Space is left between the stall title and the first row of goods. The furniture page counts roly-polys according to the actual quantity in the resource table, and the item list for new Normal Edition saves starts from the furniture the player actually owns.

旅行返程使用基础 25% 的离线邂逅概率，部分幸运物另有加成。触发时从尚未收集的.en: Return trips use a base 25% offline encounter chance, with additional bonuses from some lucky items. When triggered, a story is chosen from those not yet collected. When a new save receives a gift-box return gift for the first time, it also meets a travel friend and receives the corresponding first-meeting note.

伴蛙前行会从已有旅行、收集和制作记录补进度。官服兑换码与在线小红心在离线版计为完.en: Traveling with Frog backfills progress from existing travel, collection, and crafting records. Official-server redemption codes and online little red hearts count as completed in the offline edition; "Frogs Doing Big Things Together" can be claimed after confirming the offline return gift, and the reward is granted only once.

许愿池保留最初四次机会。商店的许愿家具礼袋可以用 3000 草重复购买，每次补一.en: The wishing pool keeps its original four chances. The stall's wishing-furniture gift bag can be repurchased for 3,000 clover, adding one floor, dining table, or dining chair not yet collected each time. Once all three are collected, buying it again refunds the amount spent.

称号、工具栏的快速滚轮停在列表边界，也可以拖动滑块或按住鼠标中键滚动。游戏加载条.en: Titles and the toolbar's quick wheel stop at the list boundaries; you can also drag the scrollbar or hold the middle mouse button to scroll. The game loading bar plays forward only once, and the landscape-orientation hint uses a larger font. Photo sharing grants qualifying offline rewards and keeps a postcard screen that can be saved as PNG or closed.

v0.2.3 接入了周末小插曲的后续期数。未提交的选择随期数结束，已提交的选择在.en: v0.2.3 added later episodes of the weekend vignettes. Unsubmitted choices end when the episode ends; submitted choices are settled the following week, and the thank-you gift can be claimed once.

本项目围绕《旅行青蛙·中国之旅》的 Android 客户端、静态资源和个人历史存.en: This project builds a locally runnable game save environment around the Android client, static resources, and personal history archives of Travel Frog: A Journey to China. Development started from login snapshot playback and gradually expanded to writable saves, daily gameplay, albums, and maps, forming two independently runnable versions: Normal and Gallery editions.

普通版已具备日志中记录的日常循环，图鉴版也已形成独立运行方案，文末继续记录后续修.en: The Normal Edition already includes the daily cycle recorded in the logs, and the Gallery Edition has formed an independent operation plan. Subsequent fixes are continued at the end of the text. This is a personal offline preservation project; some functions dependent on online services are replaced locally. Due to copyright reasons, the project content is not publicly available.

这样两套游戏可以同时安装、切换和测试，普通版的旅行进度、庭院状态和活动记录不会被.en: In this way, both game versions can be installed, switched, and tested simultaneously, and the Normal Edition's travel progress, courtyard status, and event records will not be overwritten by the Gallery Edition.

图鉴版的定位是“可查看、可试用、可继续互动的完整图鉴”，而不是把普通版的每一次获.en: The Gallery Edition is intended to be "a complete illustrated guide that can be viewed, tried, and further interacted with," rather than forcibly skipping every acquisition process of the Normal Edition. Contents collected at once are unlocked when entering the Gallery Edition: travel gear, furniture, stories, titles, friendship storybooks, handicrafts, encyclopedia, maps, souvenirs, local specialties, museum collections, and fixed travel photos can all be viewed directly.

普通版和图鉴版都将博物馆大冒险、扭蛋机、许愿池作为离线长期入口；它们不会因为原活.en: Both the Normal and Gallery editions offer the Museum Adventure, Gashapon machine, and Wishing Pool as long-term offline access points; they will not disappear when the original event ends. Advertisement and sharing-related tasks retain buttons and reward paths in both versions, and clicking offline will meet the corresponding conditions.

普通版和图鉴版分别打包为.en: The Normal and Gallery editions are packaged as

普通版和图鉴版仍严格分开。不同玩家在自己的设备上保存自己的进度，不使用作者的个人.en: The Normal and Gallery editions remain strictly separate. Each player keeps their own progress on their own device; neither the author's personal save nor a shared cloud account is used. Each edition currently has one active save. Players sharing a computer can extract separate copies into different folders. On phones or the web, export before importing another save; there is no automatic synchronization.

官服账号密码本身不是存档。官服备份仍需要先保存完整初始化数据，并额外加载相册详情.en: An official-server username and password are not a save file. Backing up official progress still requires capturing the full initialization data and loading album details separately; photo indexes alone cannot guarantee reconstruction of the original compositions. The project page provides a separate guide to enabling capture logs, browsing each module, parsing the data, importing it into the Normal Edition, and restoring the original script.

周年蛋糕的小问答同时核对了客户端实际提交的答案字段。问答现在会正确识别所选项、发.en: The minor Q&A for the anniversary cake also cross-checks the answer fields actually submitted by the client. The Q&A now correctly recognizes the selected options, issues rewards, and advances to the next step; the Normal Edition still retains the sequence of material consumption, phased waiting, crafting, sharing, and claiming rewards.

已有旅行历史的普通版与图鉴版不会被这条规则改写。.en: Normal and Gallery editions with existing travel history will not have this rule overwritten.

图鉴版的抽奖券补齐为与三叶草一致的固定资源：数量始终显示999，商店抽奖不扣减，.en: The lottery tickets in Gallery Edition are filled to match Clover, as a fixed resource: the quantity always shows 999, lottery draws in the shop do not deduct tickets, and white ball returns or other acquisition methods will not further increase it. The Normal Edition still uses the actual number of tickets with consumption rules.

普通版与图鉴版已有的同类照片均已同步迁移，新旅行生成的 dry 场景也会直接使用.en: Matching photos already present in the Normal and Gallery editions have been migrated, and dry scenes generated by new trips will use the correct coordinates directly.

图鉴版任务奖励曾出现“抽奖券实际保持999张，客户端却收到1000张”的数字不一.en: The Gallery Edition task rewards previously had a numerical inconsistency where "the lottery tickets actually remained at 999, but the client received 1000." Now, both the task reward results and lottery ticket push notifications use the fixed number for the Gallery Edition; the return results for duplicate items and calendar rewards also read the final inventory value. The Normal Edition continues to increase according to the actual quantity obtained.

在 CMD 中运行。普通版和图鉴版可独立启动，只玩其中一个时只开对应服务器即可。.en: Run in CMD. Normal and Gallery editions can start independently, and if only playing one, only the corresponding server needs to be launched.

11.电脑端操作与网页界面.en: 11. Desktop controls and the web interface

3.EAB 配置包与正式规则恢复.en: 3. EAB configuration packages and official rule restoration

分块例子换用每行 8 个 double 的模型。未分块的 ijk 每个输出元素重.en: The blocking example switches to a model with 8 doubles per line. The unblocked ijk accesses each output element by rescanning a row of A and a column of B, approximately

链接器主要看 section，加载器按 segment 建立进程的内存映像，一个.en: The linker mainly looks at sections, while the loader builds the process's memory image according to segments. A segment can contain multiple sections. Zero data in .bss has space at runtime, and the file does not need to store every zero byte.

库插桩可以记录 malloc 的请求大小和返回地址。课件对比预处理宏替换、链接器.en: Library instrumentation can record the requested size of malloc and the return address. The courseware compares preprocessor macro replacement, linker --wrap, and LD_PRELOAD during dynamic loading. Which method to use depends on whether the source code can be modified or re-linked, and whether the observed program calls the target function through dynamic symbols.
